definitions.explanation: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; not easily broken.
Having good health, not prone to illness.

examples.japanese: この{机|つくえ}は{丈夫|じょうぶ}です。
{丈夫|じょうぶ}な{体|からだ}を{作|つく}りましょう。
おじいさんは{丈夫|じょうぶ}ですね。

notes:
丈夫 is a na-adjective: 丈夫な (before nouns), 丈夫だ/です (predicate). It can describe both objects (sturdy/durable) and people (healthy).

Note: 大丈夫 (だいじょうぶ - all right, okay) is a related word. The kanji 丈 means 'length/height' and 夫 means 'man' - originally referring to a grown, strong man.
